    ti,tm=bbox(ref_idx)

    return out

def transform(grid):
    g=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    def nzseg(row):
        idx=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v!=0]
        if not idx: return None
        if idx[-1]-idx[0]+1!=len(idx): return None
        return idx[0],tuple(row[idx[0]:idx[-1]+1])
    # bar rows: consecutive identical nonzero rows with >=2 distinct colors
    bar=[]
    for i in range(h):
        s=nzseg(g[i])
        if s and len(set(s[1]))>=2: bar.append((i,s))
    run=[];best=[]
    for i,s in bar:
        if run and i==run[-1][0]+1 and s==run[-1][1]: run.append((i,s))
        else:
            if len(run)>len(best): best=run
            run=[(i,s)]
    if len(run)>len(best): best=run
    (top,(c0,seg))=best[0]; bot=best[-1][0]
    j0=c0; colors=list(seg)
    for i in range(top,bot+1):
        for j in range(j0,j0+len(colors)): g[i][j]=0
    objs=objects(tuple(map(tuple,g)),True,False,True)
    present={}
    for o in objs: present.setdefault(color(o),[]).append(o)
    ref_idx=min(colors.index(c) for c in present if c in colors)
    o=present[colors[ref_idx]][0]
    refcells=sorted((i,j) for v,(i,j) in normalize(o))
    ti,tm=uppermost(o),lowermost(o); hh=tm-ti+1
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    def stamp(cells,c,ri):
        for (i,j) in cells:
            if 0<=ri+i<h: out[ri+i][j]=c
    ri=ti-hh
    for k in range(ref_idx-1,-1,-1): stamp(refcells,colors[k],ri); ri-=hh
    ri=tm+1
    for k in range(ref_idx+1,len(colors)): stamp(refcells,colors[k],ri); ri+=hh
    return out
